description: This file contains code for translating JIT schema to C++ API types and functions in the PyTorch codebase. It defines functions for mapping schema types to C++ types, handling argument and return type conversions, and generating C++ argument bindings.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Generates a function name based on schema, considering out-parameters and symint overloads.

methods.name: valuetype_type
methods.description: Maps JIT schema value types to C++ types, handling optional and list types.

methods.name: argumenttype_type
methods.description: Converts JIT argument types to C++ argument types, considering mutability and reference semantics.

methods.name: argument_type
methods.description: Converts a JIT argument to its C++ type using argumenttype_type.

methods.name: returntype_type
methods.description: Converts JIT return types to C++ types, handling mutability and optional types.

methods.name: return_type
methods.description: Converts a single JIT return to its C++ type.

methods.name: returns_type
methods.description: Converts multiple JIT returns to a C++ tuple type.

methods.name: return_names
methods.description: Generates return variable names for a function schema.

methods.name: default_expr
methods.description: Converts JIT default values to C++ default expressions.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Converts a JIT argument or argument-like object to C++ argument bindings.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Converts a list of JIT arguments to C++ argument bindings, considering method and faithful modes.
